WITH loyalty_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM loyalty_accounts
),
scoped_orders AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.tenant_id, o.user_id, o.status, o.currency_code, o.grand_total, o.placed_at
  FROM orders o
  JOIN loyalty_members lm ON lm.user_id = o.user_id
  WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
redeem_agg AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(ABS(points)) AS points_redeemed, COUNT(*) AS redeem_tx_count
  FROM loyalty_transactions
  WHERE direction <> 'earn' AND order_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id
),
refund_payment_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM payments
  WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND amount_refunded > 0
),
refund_return_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id
  FROM order_returns
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    so.id,
    so.tenant_id,
    so.user_id,
    so.status,
    so.currency_code,
    so.grand_total,
    so.placed_at,
    CASE WHEN ra.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'points redeemed on this order' ELSE 'no points redeemed on this order' END AS order_type,
    COALESCE(ra.points_redeemed, 0) AS points_redeemed,
    CASE WHEN rpo.order_id IS NOT NULL OR rro.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_refunded
  FROM scoped_orders so
  LEFT JOIN redeem_agg ra ON ra.order_id = so.id
  LEFT JOIN refund_payment_orders rpo ON rpo.order_id = so.id
  LEFT JOIN refund_return_orders rro ON rro.order_id = so.id
),
valued AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    CASE WHEN c.status <> 'cancelled' THEN c.grand_total / er.rate ELSE NULL END AS grand_total_eur
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = c.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(c.placed_at AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  order_type,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS distinct_customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_refunded) / COUNT(*), 2) AS refund_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(grand_total_eur), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(points_redeemed), 2) AS avg_points_redeemed_per_order
FROM valued
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_type = 'points redeemed on this order' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, order_type
note: Population is scoped to orders with a non-null placed_at in 2023-2025 (orders without a placed_at, e.g. still-pending carts-to-order, can't be dated and are excluded). avg_order_value_eur is averaged only over non-cancelled orders with a matching EUR exchange rate for their placed_at date; refund_rate_pct uses all orders in the group regardless of status, per the stated refund definition.
